title: The chorus vocabulary registry
description: The single home of every closed vocabulary the suite uses. Record schemas $ref these; bin/vocab.mjs exposes them to code. An inline enum anywhere else, or a vocabulary member spelled as a bare literal in bin/, fails test/vocab-lint.test.mjs. x-names gives a code name where a member has none (an emoji); otherwise the name is the member upper-cased with every non-alphanumeric run as _.

severity.description: The three-level scale owned by GATE-PRIMITIVE.md, shared by findings and decisions; also the decision bands of DECISION-PRIMITIVE.md.

final_severity.description: Post-tally severity. 'dropped' is the demotion of a 🟢 (GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 4: 🟢→drop).

seating_band.description: How a board was seated: 🟢 a strict order at the cap (catalog row 1), 🟡 a tie at the cap (row 2).

confidence.description: Declared confidence_on_hand: epistemic sufficiency of the evidence on hand. low requires need_info (S11). Declared by the persona, never inferred.

rsvp_decision.description: The persona's own RSVP reply (I2). EXCEPTIONAL is exceptional entry beyond the cap.

failure.description: Why a persona counts as ABSTAIN under the one failure rule.

evidence_kind.description: file_line: a real anchor in the corpus. principle: an existing principle. principle_proposed: a principle named here for the first time.

need_info_stage.description: Where a NEED_INFO flag was raised: Stage 2 (author) or Stage 3 (vote).

scope.description: Gate A premise pass: the author's declared scope, confirmed by the vote.

attack_form.description: The four premise attack forms (chorus-sdlc § Gate A · 1).

tally_status.description: graded: counted. held: NEED_INFO open, not counted. ungraded: R2- derived. unvoted: every voter abstained. minority-report: exactly one non-author voter.

movement.description: What the Stage-4 rule did to a counted finding's severity.

port.description: The ports, as CONDUCTOR.md § Ports names them.

recovery_kind.description: retry: a failed persona reply sent back once. fallback: a missing optional tool replaced by its port's default. abstention: a persona counted ABSTAIN because its retry also failed.

side_note_regime.description: The declared risk regimes of CONDUCTOR.md § Side-notes.

report_mode.description: Which procedure a persona report was written for.

review_mode.description: A review round's mode: project state, or a design review of a PR's approach.

review_quorum.description: A review round's quorum branch. Named apart from gate_quorum: unifying the two is a schema-major change.

gate_quorum.description: A lifecycle gate's quorum branch. See review_quorum.

cost.description: A ranked finding's cost to fix (Phase 4).

held_route.description: The S11 resolution path a held finding is routed to.

decision_evidence_kind.description: What a decision's evidence item is.

decision_resolution.description: How a decision resolves, by band (DECISION-PRIMITIVE.md).

decision_status.description: A decision's lifecycle, field-for-field the brief entry's.

ruling_status.description: A ruling's status, field-for-field the brief's.

gate.description: Lifecycle gate ids. Paired by position with gate_name.

gate_name.description: Lifecycle gate names. Paired by position with gate.

red_team_item.description: The fixed premise-pass red-team checklist (chorus-sdlc § Gate A · 3).

red_disposition.description: What became of a gating 🔴 in its gate.

memory_noop.description: Why a persona wrote nothing at the memory update.

memory_operator.description: The operator's answer to proposed project-wide memory.

sdlc_rule.description: The lifecycle and gate-primitive invariants a complete run self-audits.

record_kind.description: Every record kind the validator knows.

run_mode.description: What a conductor run drives: a review round, an SDLC lifecycle, or a standalone premise challenge.

phase.description: The conductor's phases. A board runs rsvp → explore → author → vote → need-info; a review adds conflicts → rank → signoff; a lifecycle adds premise (Gate A), incorporate, speckit and memory.

action.description: What `conduct next` tells the agent to do: dispatch personas (or retry one), put a question to the operator, provide an input the script cannot compute (its topic says which), run a speckit cascade or skill, or stop (done: write the record; halt: the run cannot continue alone).

event.description: Run-log event types: a persona reply, a persona failure, an acknowledged free-form step, an agent or operator input.

exit.description: conduct.mjs exit meanings, one code each (x-codes). ok: done. refused: the reply or answer failed validation (a persona reply is logged as a failure). usage: bad command or arguments. version-mismatch: a reply declares another schema major (never charged). not-asked: the current action does not ask for this input (nothing logged). unreadable-log: the run log cannot be read or is not a valid run log. not-finished: record before done or halt. bad-init: init input the run log rejects (nothing written).

roster.description: The suite's persona agents, as installed, with the lens each reviews through (x-lens; ROSTER.md holds each remit) and the optional lenses seated only when their language is in scope (x-optional). Must equal .claude-plugin/plugin.json agents and agents/*.md (test/vocab-lint.test.mjs).
